Modern Large Language Model (LLM) inference is fundamentally constrained by hardware characteristics that pull in opposing directions:

- **Memory-bandwidth-bound operations** (reading weights and key/value caches) and autoregressive token emission favor low **latency** (time from request arrival to first/next token).
